decisive_locators.claim: Methods and interview list contradict a characterization as interviews with several MFA oil-deal officials.
Anonymous 1 called MFA in body but Commerce in methods and bibliography; affiliation unresolved.
Short Anonymous 1 quotation ends before 'It is the top leaders'; subsequent passage is the authors' unquoted synthesis.
Examples of limited strategic participation concern laboratories/scientists, working-level officials and a tourism-business routing problem; no company concession ceiling.
Historical institutional architecture, including complete Table 1; much predates Xi and is not a verified 2026 contact map.
